_about: DECISIONS 378: the SEO team's own method for each checklist item (their SEO_Audit_Checklist.xlsx), made by scripts/checklist_method.py: "pass" is the team's pass condition ("Beklenen / geçme koşulu"), "method" the team's way of checking ("Kontrol yöntemi"), "shared_test" the item whose test covers this one. Every pass condition also carries common_pass.
source: SEO_Audit_Checklist (1).xlsx (SEO_AUDIT Drive folder, 11 Nov 2026), read 2026-11-26: the pass condition and the check method of every item; how, action, tool and frequency are added when the builder is run on the file
